identityDesign: A compact all-mechanical stealth walker with angular navy/anthracite hull, steel-blue shoulder radiator pods, hydraulic/bearing joints, broad mechanical feet and industrial clamps. Dark navy optical visor and two navy sensor pennants recall the bandana; segmented rust-brown turret crown recalls the hair palette. No human face/skin/cloth body, no recolour of a human figure, no Raiden/REX body reuse.
equipmentReview: Mechanical equivalents preserve the source action poses, right-hand firearm direction and left support clamp; original long-suppressed SOCOM-derived compact weapon shape remains readable, deployment canister matches the source grenade gesture.
limits: Original Metal Gear-inspired machine costume, not a canonical released Metal Gear or an official Snake form.
3.4 metres is a deliberately authored design dimension, not an attested canonical measurement.
72 physical poses are native frame redraws. This release does not claim this new costume is already split into a destructible multi-part machine rig.
Rust-brown segmented crown and navy pennants are symbolic design motifs; mechanical seam/highlight placement varies slightly across poses.
Whole-body mechanical attack/KO counterparts adapt the original gameplay pose timings; no original-game robot motion capture is claimed.
Weapon-source muzzle effects and match-integrated scale/collision behaviour require Root final checks.
